shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets remain pressured with Bitcoin near $65,000 and Ethereum near $1,800 due to institutional selling and weak demand.
Stablecoin outflows are accelerating, with capital exiting crypto at the fastest pace since 2022, indicating withdrawals.
Investors await key US macro events: Fed minutes (Nov 18), US retail sales (Nov 17), and Nvidia earnings (Nov 17).
Russia implements new rules effective Nov 17, permitting limited retail investment in BTC, ETH, and USDT.
